capabilities: Pick per-note page states, layouts and accent recolours that write cssclasses frontmatter
Insert any callout type with a preview
Set the current line's checkbox task state
Apply image layouts (banner, grid, float, dark-invert) via image alt text
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese). Not yet in the community plugin list; installable via BRAT or by manually copying the folder into .obsidian/plugins/.
intentEvidence: A small companion plugin for the Opal theme.
problem: The Opal theme's per-note options (cssclasses, callout types, coloured marks, task states, image alt-text layouts) must otherwise be typed by hand with no preview of the result.

relations.evidence: This plugin only styles things that the Opal theme understands, so install and enable Opal first.

summary: Companion plugin for the Opal theme that turns per-note styling options into a visual picker with live previews for page states, callouts, highlights, tasks and images.
